# Manual: https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/Redirection.html#Redirection
# Manual: https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/Expansion.html#Command-Substitution
# Issue #686: a here-document opened in a command substitution inside a
# glob group reads its body on past the `)` the group reader stops at, so
# the substitution never closes. Top level; zsh -f -n reports: parse error
# near `x(a|$(cat <<EOF'.
echo x(a|$(cat <<EOF
hi
))
